seo_title: All {count} Pet Accessories in Adopt Me
meta_description: Compare Adopt Me Pet Accessories by rarity, body slot, sale availability, and official Bucks price to plan outfits for your pets.
intro_md: Pet Accessories let you build an outfit around your pet instead of leaving every style decision to a single hat. Body slots show where each piece sits, while rarity and availability help you separate a look you want from a purchase you can make now.
description_md:
## Finding Pet Accessories

Check availability before planning a purchase. Direct sale means the accessory has a listed Bucks price, while Hat Shop rotation means it belongs to the rotating shop selection.

Not currently sold means there is no active direct-sale or Hat Shop offer attached to that accessory. It does not explain an older obtainment route or promise a future return, so do not turn the label into a tiny fortune teller.

## Building a pet outfit

Start with the body slot you want to style. Hats sit around the head, Glasses cover the face area, Back and Wings shape the pet's outline, and Collar, Neck, Chest, and Shoes fill the smaller outfit details.

Use rarity as an item classification, not as a price guide. Accessories with the same rarity can have different sale states, and a higher rarity does not create a Bucks price when the item is not being sold.

## Reading prices and availability

A Bucks price belongs only to an accessory with an active official sale route. A blank price is not free and should not be treated as a hidden trade value.

Compare body slot first, then rarity and availability. That order keeps outfit planning useful even when the Hat Shop rotation changes and saves you from building an entire look around a price that is not there.
how_it_works_md: Body slot shows where an accessory is worn. Rarity is its official classification, Availability shows whether it is in direct sale, Hat Shop rotation, or not currently sold, and Price appears only when an official Bucks price is active.

faq_json.q: What does Hat Shop rotation mean in Adopt Me?
faq_json.a: It means the Pet Accessory belongs to the rotating Hat Shop selection instead of a permanent direct-sale offer. Check the shop to see which rotating pieces are available.

faq_json.q: What does not currently sold mean for a Pet Accessory?
faq_json.a: It means the accessory has no active direct-sale or Hat Shop offer. The label does not confirm an older obtainment route or a future return.

faq_json.q: Why do some Pet Accessories have no price?
faq_json.a: A price appears only when an accessory has an active official Bucks sale. No price does not mean the accessory is free.

faq_json.q: Is rarity the same as availability?
faq_json.a: No. Rarity classifies the accessory, while availability tells you whether it is directly sold, part of Hat Shop rotation, or not currently sold.

faq_json.q: Are Pet Accessories the same as Accessory Chests?
faq_json.a: No. Pet Accessories are wearable pieces for styling pets. Accessory Chests are separate shop items used to obtain pet wear.

wiki_md: Pet Accessories are wearable pieces used to style pets across Hats, Back, Glasses, Collar, Shoes, Chest, Neck, and Wings slots. Rarity classifies each piece, while availability and Bucks price show whether it has an active sale route. Compare the slot first so each accessory fits the outfit you are building.
